config.realtime_speech.profile_enabled_h: Only active profiles can be chosen as default and used in chat.
config.realtime_speech.profile_name_help: Display name of the profile in selection lists (up to 100 characters).
config.realtime_speech.provider_help: Service that provides the live voice connection. Changing it resets model and voice to the service defaults.
config.realtime_speech.model_help: Voice model of the service. Deprecated models are marked.
config.realtime_speech.voice_help: Voice the replies are spoken with.
config.realtime_speech.api_key_help: Access key of the service. It is stored in the vault and never kept in the browser.
config.realtime_speech.default_profile_h: Profile used when none is chosen. Only active profiles are offered.
